scope: Optional browser preference storage on restricted school computers
before: Blocking the localStorage getter with SecurityError prevented the primary workspace from mounting.
QuotaExceededError on preference writes produced errors and allowed a system theme change to override a teacher's manual selection.
changes: Sidebar preference reads and writes tolerate storage refusal; current-tab React state remains functional.
ThemeToggle tracks an explicit choice in memory even when persistence fails; storage events can still synchronize another tab's preference.

verification.chromium: Both denied-storage and full-storage scenarios passed: authenticated dashboard, sidebar collapse/expand, manual theme across system changes, upload navigation, Lite dashboard/theme/upload and zero page errors.
verification.themeRegression: 2 existing Chromium theme and teacher-review scenarios passed.
verification.productionBuild: Docker production build passed, including 87 unit tests, lint, type checking and Next.js build.
verification.finalSourceChecks: Type checking, lint, diff whitespace and secret scan passed.
verification.ci: Regression specification added to integration workflow; remote run is not claimed complete here.

limits: Preferences cannot persist after a browser restart if browser policy denies storage. These synthetic browser restrictions do not prove every enterprise policy or physical Windows 7 machine. Authentication cookies must remain allowed.
